notes.title: 10.1.0 Update - New Languages
notes.content:
Summary

This update adds 4 new languages to the game - French, Italian, German and Spanish are now all available to choose from the settings menu.

New Features

Players who played the game before 11th September 2025 will be granted a new custom white bike skin for the Downhill bike.

Improvements to existing features 

 EOS SDK updated to 1.17.1.3

 New languages added to the language selection toggle in the settings menu

notes.title: One Special Day - Development Update and Discount!
notes.content:
We're delighted to be part of the One Special Day event! Supporting an amazing charity - Special Effect. We had the pleasure of visiting some of their team. Check out the video to see what we got up to, as well as some news about our next development update. Enjoy!  

[previewyoutube="IYsGAvTu-TM;full"][/previewyoutube]

September Update Announcements
Subtitles and Localisation for EFIGS languages.

New limited edition bike for existing player community! 


October Update Announcements
MAVRIX CUP is coming! This is a standalone event / series where specific tracks will be selected with a deadline for race times to be set. It's high pressure, high stakes, winner takes all racing! 

New Race Track! This one's a fast one with crazy elevation... get ready!

Look Behind Camera! We love riding with friends, but when you're leading the train you want to see who's behind you! The look behind camera is coming to fix that!  

Performance Optimisation! We're made huge progress here.

Sponsorship Reward Items. These will be gained only through completing sponsor challenges, adding exclusivity and rewarding players who grind for their sponsors! 

Shimano Brakes! If you want to win, you'll need these brakes for extra stopping power. Our customisation list is growing.

More to be announced soon....



See you on the mountain....

notes.title: Update notes for Hotfix 10.0.1
notes.content:
This hotfix addresses two issues following our 10.0.0 release

We’ve increased the matchmaking timeout to reduce the number of people who are seeing the ‘Seatpost’ error after hitting the PLAY button.

The player’s DLSS setting will now be retained when they quit the game so it doesn’t have to be re-enabled each time.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - Community Response - NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Riders!!! We're so stoked to drop our first HUGE update, now LIVE! It's been amazing seeing feedback since our Early Access launch 1 month ago. We've been hard at work to implement key updates and features based on that very same feedback. So, here's what's new! 

Watch Video: 
[previewyoutube="jovhzIi1RLM;full"][/previewyoutube]WE'RE ADDING NEW TRICKS!
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f32a-fe0f@2x.png"]

Starting with 360's! These are triggered by pushing both sticks to the left or right. So, just like flips, these can be held for 720's, 1080's, or released to slow down rotation and land perfectly. 

Now that spins are in MAVRIX, we'll start work on tweaking the rotation axis for dipped/dumped spins. We're excited to add some serious style to these! Please do let us know what you think!
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/42c7a50bdfb209ce178861d605caef429d6e5611.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/c7ba3c59aae6d4db78f4bc3ba7f883d2d77fb517.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/f307d5f805523528099cef73630447177ae476a7.png"][/carousel]GAMEPLAY FEATURES!
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4cd@2x.png"]Session/respawn markers! You asked - we delivered. Drop a marker anywhere by pressing ‘Y’ / Triangle, then hold the same button to fast travel right back. Explore without losing your favourite spots! True freeride has arrived. Note, these currently have a 1km limit to encourage exploration with chairlifts. As ever, community feedback is welcomed to fine tune this! 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-large/1f6b2@2x.png"]Huge Suspension Enhancements! Not only have we improved our bike's suspension, the animation has been improved too. This means you now see the suspension moving over bumps/rocks/roots.  

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/23e9@2x.png"]Speed tuck mechanic! Compress the right stick to adopt a streamlined tuck position, boosting your speed. Racing is getting serious! 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f5fa-fe0f@2x.png"]Map Waypoints! Open the map and set your next destination with waypoint markers to help you navigate the world with ease. Multiple waypoints can be placed / removed.

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-large/1f9d8-200d-2642-fe0f@2x.png"]We've smoothed handlebar steering in POV. It was obvious that this looked twitchy before, which was picked up by viewers of our video content too. POV mode now looks and feels much smoother - this is extra noticeable when fine tuning steering on our new tech challenge..... 
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/77f2a1826de5b0538760d2adec1a1434963c6ab1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/1d730e1fa7625f48e3c16f112a5e16d1aaa1bebd.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/a7ad349fa22766dc3f20a96621f7af159ed6fb23.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/712570e7d963fe29f355ba5f4b62cf2e6abc32b1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/e670a373900407b35616c3efe3f32d4d2bd8af22.png"][/carousel]NEW CONTENT!
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f682@2x.png"]

New Race Track! Introducing Crazy Train.... inspired by our most popular race track in Mavrix, Helfare Hot Rod, this is 1 minute of pure speed! With a technical lower section featuring a whole new UCI Downhill inspired path type, racing is going to be intense! This major update will coincide with a leaderboard reset, to keep racing fair as the tracks are updated and short-cuts removed.

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f30a@2x.png"]

New tech challenge! 'The Deep End'! Tactically situated near Creek Side and Forest Jam, this will become a super useful fast-travel point, but only if you can complete it! This one is tough... take a deep breath!  

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f6a1@2x.png"] 

2x New Chairlift! No more long uphill pedal sessions! These two new chairlifts will get you straight to Dragons Back and Bon Voyage, so you can focus on what matters... the race back down! 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-large/26f0-fe0f@2x.png"]

A whole new mountain! Positioned behind Bon Voyage, this mountain also has a fresh freeride area giving riders a chance to put the new session markers to work! 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-large/1f918@2x.png"]

New Sponsor Challenges means more Moolah available! 

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-large/1f6d2@2x.png"]

New shop Items! With new Moolah up for grabs, we've added new Items to the shop. Including flannel shirts, white Five-Ten shoes, PinkEye Sunglasses and even an option to ride gloveless! 
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/79d2606c0901cb56f39d2def4cb05213016b0dc0.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/30daf49ead9a416d0b88c9b48d4868c236f19e86.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/8f99a831eb0d1c6987c853cad4e0decaa9dcf753.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/a15f4f491921e56994b58b8e1eec2de06007e9e1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/e9164222bb76d93677d9caf9431ff17735b718b9.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/3dede66d6b702b345e82479c073833917ea9653d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565373/55e450ec3ae8f0b657ec35020a214f927b085cc3.png"][/carousel]

Localisation:
[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f1e8-1f1f3@2x.png"]

MAVRIX is now playable in Chinese! We've started work on other languages too, which we'll announce in our next update.




MISC:
Ongoing Performance Optimisation, Enjoy smoother gameplay and better performance with NVIDIA DLSS technology.

Ongoing Bug Fixes

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/2699-fe0f@2x.png"] IMPROVEMENTS

Final checkpoint on Helfare Hot Rod moved uphill for better pacing.

No more reversing at race starts.

Trail refinement, with short-cuts removed. Jolly Good left-hip jump improved for better gameplay!

Price tags now hidden on purchased items for a tidier shop view.

Added haptic feedback for Xbox controllers (toggle off in settings menu).

Post-race experience polished.

AFK players now receive a warning message before being kicked.

Compass icons now scale and fade based on distance to points of interest.

[img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f41e@2x.png"] BUG FIXES

Main menu FPS is now capped.

Close Encounter Tech Challenge now correctly shows in Flow Fields region on the map region tracker.

Various fixes for collisions and floating landscape assets.

Leaderboard fixes ensure your position is always clearly highlighted.

Fixed a persistent blank retry prompt for players when resetting after going off-trail.

Bike skins now preview perfectly in the shop – no surprises!


What’s next?


Stay tuned because we’re just getting started! Don’t forget, your feedback is crucial. Head over to our Discord and share your thoughts, and help shape the future of MAVRIX: 

https://discord.gg/3KSxeJjt

.Thanks for riding with us — see you on the trails! Legends.



— Matt, Jono & the MAVRIX Team

[/td][/tr][/table]Summary 
This is the first post-launch release for MAVRIX. It is a patch containing mostly bug fixes for issues related to leaderboards, matchmaking, challenges, some bike controller issues and various other bugs.
Improvements to existing features 
• Matchmaking - players will be placed in servers closer to their location, using ping as a guide. 

• Removed ‘cinematic’ option from graphics settings as it isn’t intended to be a player-facing option.
Bug fixes Gameplay/UI 
Flow Fields region now shows as 100% complete rather than 0% 

Fixed bugs related to challenges: 

Players are no longer able to complete sponsor challenges requiring race mode in discovery mode. 

The second challenge of Marin sheet 3 (Frontflip, then whip within 10 seconds on trail Dragon’s back) now completes as expected. 

When completing the third challenge of Helfare, it is now possible to complete the challenge in the following region. 

Marin level 12 Poop Shoot challenge time increased to 28s

Leaderboards - resolved various issues around the leaderboard highlight not highlighting the local player correctly both on the small pre/post-race leaderboard and in the main leaderboard screen. 

Fix for bike becoming unresponsive to steering input if the player crashed whilst holding the front brake 

Fix for soft-lock if the player interacts with a chairlift whilst respawning 
Misc 
• Fixed bug where paths would occasionally appear with unnatural, often black, textures. 

• Removed log file spam related to ‘Rendering a nanite mesh to a runtime virtual texture isn't yet supported.’ 

• EULA is no longer shown briefly on every startup when launching from Epic Games Launcher. 

• Join code functionality now works more reliably.
